correctness.rationale: For each perfect matching, the product of two-qubit singlets lies in the full spin-zero subspace. The ZZ part preserves pair-opposite configurations and X flips total Z magnetization; invariance forces each pair-field difference to vanish. The intersection of the pair-opposite sector and singlets is one-dimensional; the Walsh expansion E=-sum J_pair+sum_(p<q) Q_pq xi_p xi_q forces every four-index difference Q=0. This is equivalent for N>=4 to J_ij=a_i+a_j; for N=2 every edge is additive. The identity sum_(i<j)(a_i+a_j)ZiZj=(sum a_i Zi)(sum Zi)-sum a_i proves that all singlets share energy -sum a_i and uniform transverse X annihilates them. The exact dimer energy variance sum Q²+sum field_difference² follows from Rademacher orthogonality. Independent basis-matrix variance checks on every matching for N=2,4,6 confirmed. Catalan dimension is prior representation theory, not new.
